title: A Wedding Room for Everyone
titleZh: 人人都能使用的婚礼茶室
paras: In Bell Lane, many families had little space for celebrations. The old reading room was empty most weekends, and neighbours [[rarely|rarely]] met there. So three residents, led by a baker named Amira, decided to turn it into a low-cost wedding tea room. Their main [[challenge|challenge]] was finding enough furniture without buying anything new.

Within two weeks, neighbours had provided tables, chairs and sixty cups. Each [[teacup|teacup]] was different, but together they made the tables look cheerful. Amira wrote a simple [[statement|statement]] for the door: "This room belongs to the neighbourhood. Everyone is welcome." Couples could make a [[reservation|reservation]] by calling her, and volunteers cleaned the room before each event.

The first [[bride|bride]], Lin, arrived on a wet Saturday. As [[thunder|thunder]] shook the windows, a little rain came through the roof. One volunteer looked [[confused|confused]] because the tables had been moved. However, Amira quickly explained the new plan. They placed a bucket under the leak and moved the guests to the dry side. Lin wiped a wet chair with a [[tissue|tissue]], then laughed and sat down.

After the celebration, Lin offered to [[upload|upload]] her photographs to the neighbourhood website. Other couples soon called. The small fees paid for a roof repair, and by autumn the room had hosted eight weddings. A forgotten building had become a shared place of joy.
zh: 在贝尔巷，许多家庭都没有足够的空间举办庆祝活动。旧阅览室大多数周末都空着，邻居们也很少在那里聚会。因此，以面包师阿米拉为首的三位居民决定，把它改造成一间收费低廉、可举办婚礼茶会的场所。他们面临的主要挑战是，不买任何新家具，却要凑齐足够的桌椅。
不到两周，邻居们就提供了桌子、椅子和六十只茶杯。每只茶杯都不一样，但摆在一起，让桌面显得喜气洋洋。阿米拉写了一段简短的话贴在门上：“这个房间属于整个社区，欢迎每一个人。”新人可以打电话给她预订，志愿者则会在每场活动前打扫房间。
第一位新娘林在一个下雨的星期六来到这里。雷声震得窗户发颤，一点雨水从屋顶漏了进来。一位志愿者看到桌子被挪动过，显得很困惑。不过，阿米拉很快解释了新的安排。他们在漏水处下方放了一个桶，并把宾客转移到干燥的一侧。林用纸巾擦了擦一把湿椅子，然后笑着坐了下来。
庆祝活动结束后，林主动提出把照片上传到社区网站。很快，其他新人也打来了电话。收取的少量费用支付了屋顶维修的开支。到了秋天，这个房间已经举办了八场婚礼。一座被遗忘的建筑，成了大家共享欢乐的地方。

q.s: The organisers planned to furnish the room without purchasing new furniture.
q.why: 主要挑战是不买新家具却凑齐桌椅。

q.s: Couples had to book the room at least a month before their wedding.
q.why: 只说明电话预订，未说明须提前多久。

q.s: By autumn, the room had hosted only two weddings.
q.why: 到秋天已举办八场婚礼，而非仅两场。
